key_findings: miR-155 expression in monocytes is higher in chronic migraine with medication overuse than episodic migraine and healthy controls, and correlates with monthly migraine days.
miR-155 correlated positively with IL-1β and TNF-α and negatively with IL-10 in monocytes.
